summary: Screening DANGCEM

plan the screen

The screening will first assess Dangote Cement Plc's 10-K/20-F business activities to confirm that core operations fall within permissible sectors and that ancillary revenue streams, particularly interest income, remain below Shariah thresholds. Simultaneously, financial ratios—including interest-bearing debt, cash, securities, receivables, total assets, revenue, interest income, and market cap—will be extracted via Zetaris from SEC data to compute compliance metrics such as debt-to-equity and interest-income percentage.
